# NOIR Web

NOIR Web is an unofficial browser-based Android privacy audit. It connects to an Android device over WebUSB and reads device properties, installed APKs, permissions, manifest facts and endpoints entirely in the browser, then produces a local audit report.

## Scope

- M0: WebUSB authorization, ADB authentication, device info, base APK inventory
- M1: permission and endpoint scanning, AXML, DEX URLs, risk scoring, recommendations, JSON/Markdown/CSV reports

## Privacy

Device data stays in the browser OPFS; the ADB key stays in IndexedDB. There is no backend, telemetry or upload path.
